note: Payees for the impound disbursements and the FHA MIP remittance. Ledger wallets are created at run time; these are the real-world payee identities and schedules.

fha_mip.note: FHA annual MIP is remitted to HUD monthly by the servicer from its own MIP payable. It is not part of the hazard-insurance impound and is never escrowed to the carrier.
